name: Liberty Coca-Cola Beverages - Maspeth Production Plant, NY

fieldNotes.status: ROSTER ENTRY IS OBSOLETE / MISCLASSIFIED. The Coca-Cola Maspeth PRODUCTION/BOTTLING plant no longer exists. The original bottling plant at 59-02 Borden Ave (202,000 sq ft warehouse on a 7.3-acre site) was sold to Home Depot in 2017 for $63M; Coca-Cola's triple-net lease ended March 2020 and the site became a Home Depot store. Liberty Coca-Cola Beverages' current Maspeth presence is a SALES/DISTRIBUTION CENTER at 58-40 Borden Ave (Block 2657 Lot 23, a 'fireproof warehouse'), which Liberty Coca-Cola purchased in October 2017 for ~$10.4M. Liberty's production now runs from Philadelphia PA, Moorestown NJ, and Elmsford NY - not Maspeth.
fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied '5612 56th Rd' and coords 40.726817,-73.923183. Those coordinates point to a UPS facility - the wrong building. The correct Liberty Coca-Cola Maspeth address is 58-40 Borden Ave, Maspeth NY 11378, adjacent to the Home Depot at the former Coca-Cola bottling site near the Borden Ave / Maurice Ave intersection.
fieldNotes.coords: Best-estimate ~40.7212,-73.9145, the large former Coca-Cola complex building on Borden Ave (part now Home Depot, part the Liberty Coca-Cola distribution warehouse). The Liberty Coca-Cola distribution portion (58-40 Borden Ave) could not be cleanly separated from the Home Depot portion in satellite/Street View imagery. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Estimated from the ~7.3-acre former Coca-Cola parcel - the Liberty Coca-Cola distribution portion is a subset of this; dimensions are an estimate, not a measured demised parcel.
fieldNotes.classification: All physical-layout flags left false/null because the specific Liberty Coca-Cola distribution building footprint and its truck gate / docks / yard could not be unambiguously identified and isolated from the co-located Home Depot in imagery. Type should likely be reclassified from 'Bottling / Manufacturing Plant' to 'Sales / Distribution Center'.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - dense Maspeth, Queens industrial fabric in the NYC metro.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Reclassify this roster entry: the Maspeth production plant is closed (now Home Depot). Re-audit the actual Liberty Coca-Cola Maspeth Sales/Distribution Center at 58-40 Borden Ave once its precise building footprint is confirmed.
